messages.author: Liao
messages.body:
Dear Amber fellows,
I’ve just tried to install Amber20, everything seems to be OK, but MMPBSA.py.MPI is not there. All the other MPIs as far as I noticed are installed.
I tried to just copy and paste over MMPBSA.py.MPI from Amber19, and changed the interpreter line on top so that it is being read by the amber.python from 20. But then another problem arises, that it says “Could not import mpi4py package!”
From a 2016 thread, I tried amber.python -c “import mpi4py”, and it doesn’t give any error message (just blank and next line), so that seems to be fine.
So why has MMPBSA.py.MPI failed to install for me, and is this file from Amber 19 compatible and the same with 20?
Many thanks.

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
Hi
There is a chance that your configure command had an error saying “mpi4py
not found”.
Install mpi4py and recompile amber, it should solve the problem.
